prompt: SOME PEOPLE BELIEVE THAT VIOLENCE ON TELEVISION AND IN COMPUTER GAMES HAS A DAMAGING EFFECT ON THE COCIETY. OTHERS DENY THAT THESE FACTORS HAVE ANY SIGNIFICANT INFLUENCE ON PEOPLE’S BEHAVIOUR. WHAT IS YOUR OPINION ?
essay:
Violence in television programmes and computer games has become a common concern in modern society. Some people argue that such content encourages harmful behaviour, while others believe it has little real influence on how people act. In my opinion, violent media can have a negative effect, especially on young people, although it is not the only cause of violence in society.

On the one hand, it is understandable why some people deny a direct link between violent entertainment and real-life behaviour. Millions of people watch action films or play violent games without becoming aggressive or criminal. In many cases, these forms of entertainment are simply used for relaxation, excitement, or social interaction. Moreover, behaviour is usually shaped by deeper factors, such as family background, education, poverty, and mental health. Therefore, it would be unfair to blame television and video games alone for social violence.

On the other hand, repeated exposure to violent images may gradually affect attitudes, particularly among children and teenagers. Young people are still developing their understanding of right and wrong, so they may become less sensitive to aggression if they regularly see it presented as exciting or acceptable. For example, a child who constantly plays games in which problems are solved through fighting may begin to view violence as a normal response to conflict. Furthermore, violent content can increase fear and anxiety, making society feel less safe.

In conclusion, violent television and computer games are not the sole reason for aggressive behaviour, but they can contribute to it when consumed excessively or without guidance. I believe society should not ban such content completely, but parents and governments should control children’s access to it and promote healthier forms of entertainment.
